decisions.reason: As a GIS solution platform closely tied to the firm's core direction, it likely embodies substantial development investment and public commitment, so management would tend to continue it unless failure were unmistakable.

This mobile field data capture software fits the firm's established geospatial solutions business and was visibly promoted over multiple years, which makes withdrawal less likely despite some uncertainty after 2019.

Although this search extension was still being versioned and marketed in 2019, it is a narrower add-on than a platform product, so it faces the highest discontinuation risk but would still more likely be retained under escalation of commitment.
